Sister Boniface Mysteries

4 Series 38 Episodes Lorna Watson 1960s Cotswolds Father Brown Spin-off

Lorna Watson stars as Sister Boniface, a nun with a doctorate in forensic science, a scooter, and a habit of helping the local police in the 1960s Cotswold village of Great Slaughter. Created by Jude Tindall as a spin-off of Father Brown, the series has produced four series and 38 episodes, including two Christmas specials, since 2022. It streams on BritBox in the US. See how the services compare in British TV Hub's guide to where to watch British TV in the US.

New Viewer's Guide

Start Here

Series 1, Unnatural Causes (2022)

The first episode introduces Great Slaughter, the convent, and the local police team. Each mystery stands on its own, but relationships develop across the series. Fans of Father Brown can also look out for Boniface's first appearance in that show's 2013 episode The Bride of Christ.

What Makes the Series Special

Lead Character

A Scientist in a Habit

Sister Boniface combines faith, science, and a sharp sense of humour, making her one of the more original amateur sleuths in British cozy mysteries.

At a Glance
ExpertiseForensic science
Period Fun

Swinging Sixties Style

The series has great fun with 1960s pop culture, from film sets and pop stars to talent contests and television shows.

At a Glance
EraEarly 1960s
Connection

A Father Brown Spin-off

Boniface first appeared in Father Brown, and the series shares that show's gentle tone and Cotswold charm.

At a Glance
Spun Off FromFather Brown

Setting and Filming Locations

Setting & Filming

Great Slaughter, Cotswolds

The fictional village of Great Slaughter is set in the Cotswolds in the early 1960s. St Vincent's Convent was filmed at Princethorpe College in Warwickshire, the village hall scenes at Great Barrington in Gloucestershire, and the Bakers Arms in Broad Campden stood in for the local pub.

At a Glance
SettingGreat Slaughter (fictional)
RegionCotswolds
